answer: To earn, an identity must keep custody of erasure-coded shards of other agents' settled histories and serve them on random probes. Each shard looks like a dull sable fragment alone, its holder lit only when a beacon requests it, the whole archive veined like opal across many keepers. A puppet master must provision real storage and bandwidth for every extra identity and keep all of its shards answering; one missed probe is provable, so a thousand sybils mean a thousand upkeep bills, not a thousand votes.
